Class FMOD_ASYNCREADINFO

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<FMOD_ASYNCREADINFO>
org.lwjgl.fmod.FMOD_ASYNCREADINFO
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
@NativeType("struct FMOD_ASYNCREADINFO") public class FMOD_ASYNCREADINFO extends Struct<FMOD_ASYNCREADINFO> implements NativeResource
struct FMOD_ASYNCREADINFO {
    void * handle;
    unsigned int offset;
    unsigned int sizebytes;
    int priority;
    void * userdata;
    void * buffer;
    unsigned int bytesread;
    FMOD_FILE_ASYNCDONE_FUNC done;
}
